<cite ref="Bava Kamma 91a:14">B. Kam. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>למימד גברא כמה מיקצר</he> … <he>לא מִקְצַר וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>כמה לִיקְצַר</he>) as to estimating how long a person is likely to suffer from such a wound and how long he will not, i.e. as to estimating positively the time needed for recovery, I have no doubt that we can do it.
